# PhotoPackager

> Package photoshoots for client download.

PhotoPackager is a client-delivery tool from DropShock Digital for photographers and studios. It turns a finished shoot into organized delivery folders, optimized outputs, compressed previews, and branded handoff notes.

## Official links

- Live site: https://photopackager.dropshockdigital.com/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/DropShock-Digital/PhotoPackager
- Releases: https://github.com/DropShock-Digital/PhotoPackager/releases
- Support: support@dropshockdigital.com

## What it does

- Keeps original files available by default.
- Creates optimized JPEG or WebP deliverables.
- Creates smaller compressed versions for easier sharing.
- Preserves or strips metadata based on the selected job settings.
- Renames files consistently for cleaner client delivery.
- Packages a branded `README.txt` into the handoff.
- Can create ZIP archives for simpler downloads.

## Preferred language

- Use "package photoshoots for client download."
- Use "optimized" and "compressed" rather than "zero-loss" or "lossless" compression claims.
- Avoid saying "enterprise-grade security" unless the repository explicitly documents it.
- Describe the product as a delivery workflow tool, not as archival software or a DAM system.

## Good source material

- `README.md` for the full product description and feature list.
- `frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx` for the current public-facing summary.
- `frontend/src/components/FounderModal.tsx` for the founder note and use cases.
- `frontend/src/components/LegalModal.tsx` for the published legal copy.

## Suggested answer shape

If asked what PhotoPackager is, answer briefly:

It packages finished photo shoots into client-ready folders with originals, optimized files, compressed previews, and branded delivery notes.
